text:
maria: Thanks for joining the follow-up Q&A thread — copying RCA and action items from today's all-hands. I'm dropping links and a short ask list. pls react when you've accepted an owner item.

maria: RCA here: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-456 (full timeline + mitigations). TL;DR: routing table bug + capacity mis-estimate on a spillover path.

sahil: reading now. curious — is the routing fix rolled out cluster-wide or just canaries?

maria: canaries rolled last night, still in progress. we plan full rollout after two successful 24h canaries.

emily: i'll take ownership of the rollout checklist and signal when we hit 24h. @jordan can you add the final rollout window to the ops calendar? :calendar: 

jordan: on it. adding tentative window for Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. will ping paging list before flip.

chris: noted that the incident caused a small regression in the latency SLO for embeddings. i'll open a tiny perf PR to revert the aggressive batching change that regresses tail latency. assigning to myself.

ravi: re: tests — i'll add an integration case for the routing edge that triggered the spill. timeline: EOD Friday.

anna: comms ask: marketing wants a short blurb for status page once the full rollout is done. i'll draft and post. @maria any special phrasing?

maria: keep it simple: "Issue mitigated; full rollout in progress; follow-up RCA published." we'll add follow-up note when finished.

maggie: can we get a consolidated action board link? makes triage easier.

maria: yes — tracker + owner column here: https://linear.redwood.ai/boards/INC-2026-456-actions (please add comments when you start).

ops-bot: deploy-log: canary-2026-03-18T23:12Z -> success; canary-2026-03-19T04:10Z -> success. (automated)

emily: accepted: rollout checklist -> emily (due: 2026-03-20).

chris: accepted: rollback perf tweak -> chris (due: 2026-03-19).

ravi: accepted: integration test -> ravi (due: 2026-03-20).

jordan: added calendar invite and included oncall rotation. will update if window shifts.

anna: drafting status blurb now; will drop to tracker for review in ~30m.

maria: one more ask — post-deploy verification steps (latency, error-rate, cache-hit) need owners. i'll own cache-hit checks, @chris takes latency, @sahil will watch error-rate.

sahil: watching error-rate; will alert if >0.5% for 15m.

maria: thanks all. i'll circle back after the full rollout or sooner if anything changes. :heart:

maria: ACTION SUMMARY (copy to tracker):
- emily: rollout checklist + execute full rollout after canaries (due 2026-03-20)
- chris: revert/regression PR for batching (due 2026-03-19)
- ravi: integration test for routing edge (due 2026-03-20)
- anna: draft status page blurb & publish post-rollout (due 2026-03-20)
- jordan: schedule final window & notify oncall (done)
- maria: post-deploy cache-hit verification (owner)
- sahil: post-deploy error-rate watch (owner)

maria: ping here if you need help or want to reassign. we'll close the loop in the next all-hands follow-up thread.

sahil: thanks — quick Q: should we also surface the regression test to the model-onboarding checklist? seems related.

maria: yes please — ravi, can you add a note in the onboarding checklist to run the routing integration?

ravi: done, added checklist item and a short repro snippet in the tracker comment.

emily: all set from my side, will start full rollout after 24h canary green. :thumbsup:
